title: PCSO Lotto Results: P236M Grand Lotto prize up for grabs as no winners of major jackpot draws on September 30
summary: There were no winners of either of the major lotto draws on September 30, 2026, as the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot reached over P236 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said…

blocks.text: There were no winners of either of the major lotto draws on September 30, 2026, as the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot reached over P236 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Wednesday.
No one chose chose the winning numbers of 44-28-48-38-23-42 for the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize of P236,623,866.82.
According to PCSO, the odds of winning the jackpot for the Grand Lotto 6/55 are 1 in 28,989,675. To win, bettors must match all six numbers chosen from a field of 1 to 55.
Winners remained elusive as well for Megalotto 6/45, with no bettors picking the combination of 41-35-29-23-20-06 that would have yielded the P83,372,178.85 jackpot.
